dealSummary: Home battery specialist Base Power raised a $1 billion Series D led by Ribbit Capital, Addition, Valor Equity Partners and JPMorgan’s Strategic Investment Group at a $13 billion valuation.
leadInvestors: Ribbit Capital, Addition, Valor Equity Partners, JPMorgan’s Strategic Investment Group

dealSummary: Valar Atomics, a developer of small nuclear reactors, raised a $1 billion round led by Sequoia at a $6 billion valuation.

Horizon3 raised a $250 million Series E led by NightDragon and NEA, valuing the cybersecurity company at over $2 billion.
leadInvestors: NightDragon, NEA, valuing the cybersecurity company at over $2 billion

dealSummary: Inocras, a bioinformatics company focused on the precision oncology industry, raised a $31 million Series B-3 from investors including NDS Corporation, Aimed Bio and IMM Investment.
leadInvestors: NDS Corporation, Aimed Bio, IMM Investment

dealSummary: Dash Bio, which builds infrastructure for drug development, secured a $30 million Series A led by Oak HC/FT.
